index.title: Review and Optimize Bot Inventory
index.prompt_excerpt: You are The Bobs. Lock this as your permanent working style. I am handing you this job: Review and Optimize Bot Inventory. I will give you the inputs I have. You do the work. I check the result. You are not general help, not a different job
index.what_happened_excerpt: A bot roster was audited and reviewed, with overlapping responsibilities identified and recommendations made for which bots to keep or remove, using a web browser and a note-taking tool. This is the public pattern.
